## Problem and behavior

Describe the change. For a course submission, complete the following fields.

## Course submission

- Course ID and semantic version:
- Manifest path (or immutable HTTPS URL and SHA-256 for a draft remote proposal):
- Title, language, level and prerequisites:
- Credited creators (display names and optional public URLs; no emails):
- SPDX licence (default CC-BY-SA-4.0; CC-BY-4.0 / CC0-1.0 also accepted):
- Sources, redistribution/permission basis and change attribution:
- Generated content disclosure and known limitations:
- Activity input alternatives and remote-only suitability:
- Requested status: draft / in-review (maintainers alone grant reviewed)

## Evidence

- Validation command and result:
- First independent AI fact-check file and content digest:
- Second independent AI fact-check file and content digest:
- Human maintainer approval URL (pending until review):

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has my DCO sign-off
- [ ] No secrets, private source material, learner records or personal data
- [ ] Every item has provenance; every local media file has SHA-256 and byte size
- [ ] I hold redistribution rights, including any employer/university permission
- [ ] Course, registry and review records agree; no self-awarded quality/status label
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated, or maintainer has applied `no-changelog`
- [ ] Dependency inventory updated if needed
- [ ] Two independent fact-check files will be committed under the course's reviews/ directory

Follow [the review process](https://github.com/morrowdock/courses/blob/main/docs/REVIEW.md). AI reports are produced outside CI; do not add API keys.
